title: Ave Maria (immaculate Mary)
content:
Lied auf Youtube anhören

1. Immaculate, Mary!
Our Hearts Are On Fire.
That Title So Wondrous
Fills All Our Desire!

Refrain:
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!

2. We Pray For Our Mother,
The Church Upon Earth.
And Bless, Sweetest Lady,
The Land Of Our Birth.

Refrain:
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!

3. For poor, sick, afflicted
they mercy we crave
and comfort the dying
thou light of the grave

Refrain:
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!

4. In grief and temptation
in joy or in pain,
we’ll ask thee, or mother,
nor seek thee in vain

Refrain:
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!

5. In death’s solemn moment,
our mother, be night;
as children of Mary
O teach us to die

Refrain:
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!

6. And crown thy sweet mercy
with this special grace
to behold soo in heaven
God’s ravishing face.

Refrain:
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!

7. Now to God be all glory
and worship for aye
and to God’s virgin mother
and endless ave.

Refrain:
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria!
